item.title: Show HN: Fly through your LinkedIn network in a 3D galaxy (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description:
By end of next week, LinkedIn's gonna disable EU users' personal data export. I personally think the data is quite useful, especially connection data around companies & positions.

So I built a tool that (1) guides you through the LinkedIn export, (2) allows you to fly through your LinkedIn network in a snazzy galaxy look (completely useless but pretty, thanks Astra) and (3) crunches the data to give you recommendations on potential starting points for ideas.

Background is that as VCs, we look hard at "Founder Market Fit" and a few months back I just wanted to build a tool that would give me some pointers towards sectors where I already had critical mass of "people to talk to", for whatever, business ideas in a certain sector, who do I know already at interesting companies, etc.

Anyhoo, with that recent realization that LinkedIn's gonna close that off, I thought I'd share this here and then I'll try and build around Gmail and Outlook + enrichment next, and in any case, there's much to do with the enrichment algos, so if you're interested in flying through your network or just test-driving this, have at it.

Happy to hear thoughts!
